einzeiler: Republican midterm convention absence, primary results, and West Bank violence.
kurzfassung: Republican lawmakers offer excuses for skipping Trump's midterm convention while the president announces new merchandise and plans. Dan and Jon discuss Ed Markey's primary win, Kamala Harris, and a new Democratic line of attack regarding data centers. Journalist Jasper Nathaniel also joins to discuss violence in the West Bank.
stichpunkte: Republican lawmakers skipping Trump's midterm convention
Trump's announcements regarding midterm ads and coins
Ed Markey's primary win over Seth Moulton
Kamala Harris and red-state Democrats refusing support
Democrats' new line of attack connecting data centers to tax provisions
Jasper Nathaniel discussing reporting on violence in the West Bank
beschreibung:
Dozens of Republican lawmakers tell the press that they won't be attending Trump's midterm convention next week, citing a variety of unconvincing excuses, but the president seems unfazed by his party's lack of enthusiasm for more Trump, announcing Trump midterm ads, Trump coins, and the possibility he may rename the Strait of Hormuz to the Trump Strait.
Dan and Jon preview the pity party and then react to Ed Markey's primary win over Seth Moulton, Kamala Harris brushing off red-state Democrats refusing her support, and the Democrats' new line of attack against the GOP — tying the construction of data centers to a tax provision in the Big Beautiful Bill. Then journalist Jasper Nathaniel stops by the studio to talk to Tommy about his reporting on violence in the West Bank.
